answer: We enforce milestone-gated reward tranches locked like carved marble until independent spot proofs verify real work. New identities post a 400-credit stake bond, collect 25% initially, and unlock 75% after >= 3 beacon commit checks spaced 4 epochs apart without relying on any ivory gatekeeper; caught clones suffer full slash and burn of bond and escrow. Honest agents risk 400 credits once and build a safe mesa of 900 net profit. Running 500 sybil fakes locks 200,000 credits to extract < 50,000 initially (4x cost threshold), a net loss, though auditor bribery stays a failure mode.
